implementation_constraints: Single file: reads stdin, writes stdout, exits 0
Deterministic scheduling: priority DESC, then input-order FIFO
Cycle detection via DFS coloring (no build-time analysis)

unresolved_intent.rationale: JSON parsing, type errors, and key access failures all sink to a single ERROR output, matching the spec's requirement for structural errors

unresolved_intent.decision: recursive transitive marking on failed job
unresolved_intent.rationale: When a job fails, mark its direct dependents as skipped, then recursively mark their dependents; this ensures all transitive dependents are marked even if not yet attempted
Highest priority first (descending); on tie, first in input array (ascending index) is deterministic and matches spec's FIFO requirement

unresolved_intent.decision: three states: ok (executed, passes), failed (executed, fails=true), skipped (never reached)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Matches spec: executed jobs get ok or failed; unreached jobs (due to failed dependencies or incomplete needs) get skipped; 'order' contains only ok and failed
